title: Evidence Ledger — so nguon nang cap cho bao cao tai chinh
description: Nang cap tu window.SRC/window.RPT kieu reference-kimi.html: SRC la so nguon (K1..K30, moi entry co cat/date/fact/cite) nhung KHONG co lien ket tuong minh toi tung con so trong RPT. Ledger nay tach hai lop: 'sources' (dang ky nguon, 1 nguon dung nhieu lan) va 'values' (moi con so hien thi, bat buoc tro ve dung 1 source_id).

_doc.description: Ghi chu cho nguoi mo file ra doc, khong tham gia doi chieu. `_doc` la quy uoc dung o moi file JSON cua repo (xem charts/schema.vocab.json) nen schema phai cho phep, neu khong thi moi so nguon co ghi chu deu FAIL vi mot ly do khong lien quan gi toi bang chung.

loose_date.description: Cho phep YYYY, YYYY-MM, hoac YYYY-MM-DD (du lieu vi mo hay tro ve nam/thang, khong phai luc nao cung co ngay).

tier.description: Thang bac do tin cay, GIAM DAN: T1 cong bo chinh thuc (co quan nha nuoc, luat/nghi dinh, to chuc da phuong WB/IMF/GSO) > T2 bao cao kiem toan (BCTC da kiem toan, cong bo doanh nghiep co xac nhan kiem toan) > T3 broker/nghien cuu thi truong (cong ty chung khoan, Mordor, McKinsey) > T4 uoc tinh noi bo (tu tinh tu du lieu that, co cong thuc kiem tra duoc) > T5 suy dien (derived/extrapolation, kieu pheu TAM-SAM-SOM).

sensitivity.description: public = duoc phep trich dan day du cho ban gui khach (so lieu da cong bo cong khai, vd World Bank/GSO/Nghi dinh da ky cong bao). internal_only = chi hien trong ban noi bo; ban gui di PHAI dung public_label thay the, khong duoc lo ten co quan/kenh tin/nguoi trong mang luoi.

org.description: Ten to chuc phat hanh (World Bank, NHNN, Mordor Intelligence...). CHI dung khi sensitivity=public trong ban gui di; ban noi bo luon duoc xem.

cite.description: Trich dan day du: ten bao cao, ma so lieu, ky.

public_label.description: BAT BUOC neu sensitivity=internal_only. Cau thay the da duyet theo bang quy doi (memory feedback_no_source_disclosure_in_artifacts), dung nguyen van khi export ban external, khong duoc dien giai lai tuy hung.

id.description: ID duy nhat cua con so, dung de gan voi data-evid trong HTML.

display.description: Chuoi hien thi dung nhu trong HTML (vd '16,0 ty USD'), dung de doi chieu chong lech.

unit.description: Don vi chuan hoa (vd 'ty USD', 'trieu USD', '%'). Phai giong het nhau trong cung mot chart_id.

source_id.description: Phai khop dung 1 entry trong sources[]. Khong duoc mo coi.

retrieved_date.description: Ngay lay so ve, khong duoc o tuong lai so voi ngay chay validator.

tier.description: Ban sao co chu y cua source.tier; validator bat loi neu lech nhau (tranh nang cap/ha cap tier ngam khi ghi value).

chart_id.description: Nhom bieu do/bang de kiem don vi nhat quan trong cung 1 nhom.
